description: Two record types told apart by a COMP-1 value resolved under IEEE 754, where LIMIT-RECORD's literal is positive infinity, read under hexadecimal floating point. HFP has no infinity, so the literal cannot be held exactly and the consumer refuses the axes before any record is read.
source: docs/ir/SPEC.md, "What cannot be re-expressed is refused before any record is read", a number the read float format cannot hold exactly; "Each axis carries a literal the way a file crosses it", the float format row
